description: Defines a final class DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer that implements the MessageConsumer interface. It manages a device-specific command consumer, delegating calls to a Supplier of DestinationCommandConsumer, including methods for closing the consumer, managing flow control, and retrieving remaining credits.

classes.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
classes.description: Represents a device-specific command consumer that delegates its operations to a wrapped consumer obtained via a Supplier, with methods for closing, flow control, and credit management.

methods.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with a supplier of the delegate consumer and the device ID, ensuring non-null arguments.

methods.name: getDelegate
methods.description: Returns the current delegate consumer obtained from the supplier; may be null if consumer is closed or unavailable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the consumer by delegating to the actual consumer. If the delegate is unavailable, executes the closeHandler with a failed future.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Increases the flow credit by delegating to the current consumer if available.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the remaining consumer credit, 0 if delegate consumer is unavailable.
